title: Yummy Kyushu Tomatoes Inari Sushi
description: A briny, velvety brunch-mood sushi that marries tinned tomatoes with sweet inari, perfect for a quick yet satisfying meal.
instructions: Rinse 200g sushi rice under cold water until the water runs clear, then drain.
Combine rinsed rice with 250ml water in a saucepan, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes until water is absorbed.
In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1 tsp salt until dissolved; pour over cooked rice, fold gently, and let it cool to room temperature.

While the rice cools, heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a non‑stick skillet over medium heat and sauté the drained diced tomatoes for 4 minutes, adding 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp mirin, then stir in chopped basil, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Warm the sweet tofu skin pouches briefly in a microwave for 20 seconds to soften them slightly.
Divide the cooled rice into 12 equal portions, each about 15g, and gently press each portion into a separate inari pouch, forming a small mound.
Spoon a tablespoon of the tomato mixture onto each mound of rice, then top with a pinch of sesame seeds.
Roll each inari pouch loosely around the filling, using a bamboo mat if desired to keep the shape.
Slice each roll into 6 bite‑size pieces and serve immediately.
